BiblicalUsage: Eperotema is an inquiry, an answer — and Peter uses it once, in the verse about baptism: not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, by the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: Baptism is an answer, not a bath, I believe: a conscience speaking to God, grounded in a risen Christ.
